facts.fact: The strategy states Morocco adopted its first national cybersecurity strategy in 2012.

The DGSSI publishes the Stratégie Nationale de Cybersécurité 2030 as the successor to the 2012 strategy, with 4 pillars, 11 objectives, 26 initiatives and 60 actions; the document is undated and its date here is the 2024 published proxy.
The strategy's legal timeline states Décret n° 2-11-509 created the DGSSI in 2011.
